title: MoraXtreme 6.0
description: A hardware-meets-software hackathon run by the IEEE Student Branch, pairing embedded systems challenges with a software track. Teams get access to a sponsor-provided hardware lab for the full 24 hours.
location: Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
whoCanParticipate: Open to all undergraduates. At least one team member should have basic embedded systems experience.
